title: Empty support and the zero multi-index
statement: Let $B$ be a finite Fourier basis with distinguished index $0_B$, and let $a:	ext{Fin}(n)\to\iota$ be a multi-index. Its support, the set of coordinates $i$ for which $a(i)\ne 0_B$, is empty if and only if $a(i)=0_B$ for every coordinate $i$, that is, $a$ is the zero multi-index.
